title: PCP connection record
description: The file connections/<id>.json in an export archive (SPEC §8.5 item 5): a connection's configuration without credentials. Unknown top-level members fail, so a field such as access_token cannot travel unnoticed. Setting names that look like credentials fail too; that is a backstop, not proof that a value holds no secret.

id.description: The connection id (SPEC §6.1 item 2, §6.4): the same id its tools and conn.<id> scopes use.

type.description: The kind of service the connection links to, for example notion or imap.

label.description: What a person sees to tell this connection from others of its type.

enabled.description: Whether the connection was enabled at export time. After a restore it still cannot be used until the controller authorizes it again (SPEC §8.7.2 item 5).

settings.description: Configuration that does not grant access to the source. Importers ignore settings they do not understand (SPEC §8.5 item 5).

credentials_included.description: Always false: no tokens, passwords, keys or cookies for the source travel (SPEC §8.2 item 8).
